data.timestamp_convention: New York wall clock encoded as UTC

predeclared_definition.normalization: causal log1p volume z-score by second-of-session over the prior 20 observations
predeclared_definition.direction: canceled bid layer -> short; canceled ask layer -> long
predeclared_definition.ambiguity: skip seconds where both sides qualify

kill_test.rule: default 15-second net edge > 0, t >= 2, and bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero

checks.name: no CV block worse than -2x mean block

ml.note: One fixed classifier, C, threshold, and feature set; no model family or probability-threshold search.

notes: All QuestDB access was read-only; caches live under sandbox/.cache.
No server, feature builder, or raw table was changed.
Calendar/side filters and sizing rows inspect OOS and are not adopted.
The ML experiment uses one fixed model and cannot authorize a retry.
Promotion requires both the pre-grid kill test and the standard walk-forward/CV gate.
Databento ends 2026-07-16, so July 2026 is partial.
